scorecard.promise: Improvement in AI segment performance via better agrochemical volumes in H2 FY26
scorecard.quote: in the AI segment, we anticipate an improvement in performance on the back of better volumes for agrochemical-linked intermediates from Europe as well as other geographies
scorecard.outcome: AI revenue rose from INR 588 cr (Q2 FY26) to INR 804 cr (Q1 FY27). Quarterly financials show revenue growth resumed in Dec 2025.

scorecard.outcome: Unverifiable. Later calls discuss MIBK/MIBC commissioning in Q2 FY27, but do not explicitly confirm the status of the specific upstream assets mentioned in Nov 2025.

scorecard.promise: Multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK/MIBC projects commissioning in Q2 FY27
scorecard.quote: our multipurpose agrochemical intermediates and MIBK, MIBC projects, which are scheduled for commissioning in Q2 FY27.
scorecard.outcome: Aug 2026 call confirms MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone commissioned in August (Q2 FY27), with others on track for the same quarter.

scorecard.promise: Commission MIBK, MIBC, and acetophenone in August 2026
scorecard.quote: MIBK as well as MIBC will be commissioned along with acetophenone in August itself, and the rest of them will be commissioned within Q2.
scorecard.outcome: Q2 FY27 results show a significant revenue jump to INR 3,091 crore, supporting the commissioning and scale-up of new assets.

scorecard.promise: Q3 FY27 EBIT % to be between Q1 and Q2 levels, closer to Q1
scorecard.quote: So we expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2, I think closer to Q1 in terms of percentage... I would assume that in Q4 EBIT percentage should be better than Q3.
scorecard.outcome: Tracking. Q1 FY27 OPM was 21% and Q2 FY27 was 20%. Outcome for Q3 FY27 is not yet reported in the provided data.

scorecard.promise: Annualized improvement in Advanced Intermediates segment from next year onwards
scorecard.quote: And on an annualized basis from next year onwards, we should see further improvement.
scorecard.outcome: Tracking. AI revenue already showed growth to INR 804 cr by Q1 FY27; full annual impact expected in FY28.

credibility.summary: Management demonstrates high credibility regarding project timelines, successfully commissioning MIBK/MIBC assets as scheduled. They tend to provide specific, achievable operational milestones rather than vague targets.

narrative_vs_numbers: Revenue growth narrative aligns with numbers, showing a sharp jump from INR 2,120 cr (Mar 2026) to INR 3,076 cr (Sep 2026) following project commissioning.
Margin expansion story is supported by OPM increasing from 11% in Sep 2025 to 20% in Sep 2026.
The 'improvement in AI segment' narrative is validated by the segment revenue increasing from INR 588 cr to INR 804 cr within three quarters.

calls.tone: Confident and optimistic, supported by record performance and strategic asset commissioning.

guidance.statement: We expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2, closer to Q1, and Q4 EBIT percentage should be better than Q3.
